paragraphs.text: Radrik is a kor cleric ally from Zendikar and brother of Ayli .

Radrik is a cleric of the Kor wind-goddess Kamsa . He entered his study of the goddess at an early age, along with his younger sister Ayli. The nomadic siblings became renowned for their wisdom and guidance for troubled souls, but the more insightful Ayli quickly outshined him. Disillusioned and envious, Radrik stopped traveling with his sister and joined up with an expedition to Jwar Isle, and ever since has offered his healing talents to adventurers.
